title: Catalog
subtitle: The curated catalog of approved capabilities — agents, MCPs, skills, templates, models and connectors — plus governed self-service instantiations.

entries.name: Name
entries.emptyHint: Create a draft entry, submit it for review, and approve it to publish a frozen, hash-pinned version.
entries.truncated: Loaded {{n}} catalog entries; there are more
entries.truncatedHint: There are more catalog entries than shown; this page takes rows by id. An entry missing from this list does not prove it does not exist.

signing.unsignedHint: Hash-pinned and ledger-attested, but not signed (no catalog signing key configured at approval).

verify.title: Integrity
verify.caption: Recomputed at open time. The signing key never leaves the engine — only its fingerprint is shown.
verify.verifiedHint: The content hash matches the pinned hash and the signature is valid.
verify.verifiedHashOnlyHint: The content hash matches the pinned hash. This version is hash-pinned and ledger-attested, but unsigned.
verify.notVerifiedHint: The recomputed hash or signature does not match what was pinned at approval. Do not treat this version as approved.
verify.pendingHint: Nothing is pinned until the entry is approved. Verification applies to approved and deprecated versions.

posture.title: Catalog signing posture
posture.publicKeyHint: The Ed25519 public key for external verification — intentionally public, not a secret.
posture.disabledNote: No catalog signing key is configured. Approved entries are hash-pinned and ledger-attested, but unsigned.

detail.title: Entry detail
detail.specCaption: Read-only definition. Secrets are referenced inside the spec by name or locator — never as values. Inline credentials are rejected on write.
detail.notApprovedYet: Not approved yet — nothing is pinned or signed.

editor.name: Display name
editor.slugHint: Lowercase letters, digits, “-” and “_”, up to 64 characters.
editor.specHint: Optional JSON object. Reference secrets by name or locator — never embed a credential. Inline credentials are rejected.
editor.specInvalid: The specification must be a valid JSON object.
editor.credentialWarning: That looks like a credential value. Reference secrets by name or locator (e.g. $GITHUB_TOKEN or a vault path), never the secret itself.
editor.draftNotice: New entries are created as a draft. Lifecycle and integrity fields (status, hash, signature, approver) are managed by the engine — never set here.
editor.admissionStaleWarning: This {{kind}} entry has a recorded admission verdict. Saving a changed specification invalidates it — you must admit a fresh attestation before it can be approved.

admission.title: Attestation admission
admission.caption: The recorded provenance/SBOM verdict that gates approval into the served catalog — the durable record of why this entry was admitted or refused.
admission.noneHint: Under an enforcing admission policy this entry cannot be approved until a verified attestation is admitted.
admission.admitBodyMcp: Verify a Sigstore attestation bundle (cosign download attestation / gh attestation download) for this MCP server against the tenant trust root. Only a verified verdict lets an enforcing policy approve it into the served registry.
admission.admitBodyConnector: Verify a Sigstore attestation bundle for this connector artifact against the tenant trust root. The expected digest defaults from spec.artifact_digest; only a verified verdict lets an enforcing policy approve it as a verified connector.
admission.bundleHint: Paste the Sigstore bundle JSON. It is verified server-side; nothing is recorded until it is parsed.
admission.bundleInvalid: The bundle must be valid JSON.
admission.expectedDigestHint: Optional sha256 the attested subject must match (e.g. sha256:…). For connectors it defaults from spec.artifact_digest.
admission.recordedNotAdmitted: Recorded, but the attestation did not satisfy the policy — see the verdict.

confirm.deleteBody: Delete this draft entry permanently? This cannot be undone. Only drafts can be deleted; approved entries must be deprecated instead.
confirm.submitBody: It moves to “pending” and is no longer editable as a draft until decided.
confirm.approveBody: Approval is FINAL: the version is frozen and made immutable, its content hash is pinned (and signed if signing is enabled), and it becomes available for self-service instantiation. To retire it later you must deprecate, not delete.
confirm.deprecateBody: It will be retired and hidden from new instantiations, but its history and signature are kept so it stays verifiable. This cannot be reversed — publish a new version instead.

instantiate.title: Request an instantiation
instantiate.body: This creates a governance request (status “requested”) attributed to you — it does NOT provision anything yet. The approval decision is governance’s and provisioning is deployment’s; an admin must approve and activate it.
instantiate.name: Instance name
instantiate.nameHint: A unique name for this instantiation of the entry.
instantiate.notApproved: Only an approved entry can be instantiated.

instances.name: Name
instances.emptyHint: Self-service instantiations of approved entries appear here with their governance status.
instances.liveNote: Live — refreshing while requests await a governance decision.
instances.truncatedHint: There are more instances than shown; this page takes rows by id. An instance missing from this list does not prove it does not exist.

instanceDetail.title: Instance detail
instanceDetail.governanceCaption: Transitions follow the allowed flow and are recorded against your identity. The policy/HITL is governance; real provisioning is deployment.

transition.body: Approving, rejecting or activating is recorded against your identity in the audit ledger and follows the allowed flow (requested → approved/rejected, approved → active/rejected).

entry.title: No catalog entries created yet
entry.description: Create a draft entry, submit it for review, and approve it to publish a frozen, hash-pinned catalog version.

instance.title: No instantiation requests yet
instance.description: Approve a catalog entry, then request an instantiation to create its governed instance record here.

mcp.title: MCP entries
mcp.body: Trust anchors that gate federated MCP entries into the served sub-registry.

connector.title: Connector entries
connector.body: Trust anchors that gate third-party connector entries before approval.

unconfigured.title: No policy — every entry is admitted
unconfigured.body: With no policy configured, entries are admitted WITHOUT any signature check. Configure a trust anchor to gate admission.

observe.title: Configured — observe only
observe.body: Signatures are verified and recorded, but a failure does not block admission. Turn on “require signed” to enforce.

enforce.title: Enforcing
enforce.body: Entries that do not verify against these trust anchors are refused admission.

policy.requireSignedHint: When on, an entry that does not verify is refused.
policy.requireSubjectDigestHint: Bind the attestation to the entry’s digest, not just its name.
policy.identitiesHint: One per line. Must be set together with issuers.
policy.issuersHint: One per line. Must be set together with identities.
policy.predicatesHint: One per line, e.g. the provenance predicate type. Blank lines are rejected.
policy.trustedRootsHint: CA certificates in PEM. Only whole BEGIN…END blocks are saved.
policy.trustedKeysHint: PUBLIC keys in PEM. Only whole BEGIN…END blocks are saved.
policy.editBody: Changes take effect on the next admission.
policy.loadFailed: Could not load the admission policy.
policy.confirmBody: This tightens admission or removes a trust anchor. Entries admitted under the old policy are not re-checked, but new admissions may fail until they are re-signed.

err.privateKey: Trust material must be public — remove any PRIVATE KEY block.
err.pemResidual: Only whole BEGIN…END blocks are saved; remove the leftover text.
err.emptyPredicate: Predicates must not contain blank entries.
err.anchorMissing: Enforcement needs at least one trusted root or key, or nothing would be admitted.
err.identityIssuer: Identities and issuers must be set together, or neither.
